title: Expected Nonhalting Bound from Uniform Halting
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $t_0\in\mathbb{N}$. If every branch of $N$ on $x$ has halted within $t_0$ steps, then for every $K\in\mathbb{N}$, the sum over $t=0,\ldots,K-1$ of the probability that a uniformly chosen length-$t$ choice word leaves the run unhalted is at most $t_0$.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite-state nondeterministic machine over Bool
Every choice word of every length t₀ leads N on x to a halted configuration
